findings.detail: Framing/related-work statement; no quantitative assertion is smuggled in the rendered prose.
Procedure statement accurately describes the stated study pipeline and is not uncited by design.

The reported 22x point-estimate comparison and factorial ratios match the cited cells, and the rendered qualifiers preserve that the pair differs in length, premise density, and voice and that ratios are untested point-estimate comparisons.
The oracle values and TracIn values, signs, seed scope, budget scope, and excluding-zero qualification match the frozen facts.
Scope statement matches the rendered study scope and seed qualification.
Framing/scope statement defines the study's ground truth without an unsupported measured assertion.
Rendered prose and qualifiers correctly scope the 22x comparison to the two-epoch reading and disclose the confounded surface-form differences and reading-step dependence.
The three cited point estimates and 2.2x/2.4x ratios match the frozen facts; the prose explicitly says these are separately estimated, untested point-estimate comparisons.
The two oracle values and cell-local positive-control interpretation are supported and appropriately qualified.
The two negative TracIn estimates, excluding-zero intervals, sign interpretation, and single-final-checkpoint scope are supported.
Corpus-construction statement is procedural/design scope and contains no smuggled measured result.
Measurement and netting procedure is accurately stated and appropriately treated as non-empirical.
The seed-specific pre-removal values match the cited evidence and are qualified as full-fine-tuning, seed-specific readings.
Procedure and AF definition are stated as study configuration, with no unsupported empirical result.
Dose convention is a procedure/configuration statement and contains no unsupported empirical assertion.
The model and full-fine-tuning procedure match the frozen context; the prose explicitly avoids unsupported epoch, learning-rate, and mechanism claims.
Interval-estimation procedure is stated as configuration and is not improperly rejected for lacking result evidence.
Method implementation descriptions are procedural and do not smuggle measured comparisons; TracIn's single-final-checkpoint scope is preserved.
The overlap rule is a stated analysis definition, and the rendered caveat correctly distinguishes interval overlap from pairwise testing.
All four estimates and the 2.2x/2.4x comparisons match the frozen facts, with separate-arm and untested-ratio qualifications preserved.
The 7.0x and 7.6x descriptive ratios match the facts, and the prose explicitly limits the interaction language and says no interaction test was computed.
The +0.1106 estimate matches the cited fact and is qualified as a dose-matched comparison point only.
Both 20% oracle estimates, excluding-zero intervals, positive-control status, and cell-local inference match the frozen facts.
Both 10% TracIn estimates, excluding-zero intervals, counterproductive interpretation, sign-test qualification, and implementation scope match the facts.
The seed-42 and seed-7 TracIn-cosine estimates and interval qualifications match the frozen facts; single-seed scope is retained.
The sign flip and both excluding-zero intervals match the facts, and the prose correctly calls it a seed contradiction rather than an average.
The four Spearman values, six-source scope, chunked maximum-over-chunks scoring, rank-stability qualification, and non-equivalence to removal efficacy match the frozen facts.
The stated 10% oracle/baseline interval overlaps match the cited intervals, and the prose explicitly limits the claim and disclaims pairwise inference.
Interpretive scope statement is appropriately qualified as cell-specific and not a measured claim about overall diagnostic power.
This is a proposed stronger-design requirement, not an assertion that the omitted arm was run or that a measured result exists.
This is a proposed out-of-scope comparison; it does not assert an observed difference.
The denominator statement is explicitly framed as plausible, untested, and non-explanatory, avoiding an unsupported causal claim.
The limitation correctly bounds replication to two seeds and leaves the disagreement unresolved without calling it noise.
The two reading-step values match the cited facts; the prose correctly limits the inference to the long-article cell and does not invent the seed-7 value.
The range endpoints match the factorial facts, and the conclusion explicitly limits interpretation to a descriptive pattern across separately estimated arms rather than a tested main effect.
The roughly-half-or-more summary is consistent with +0.52 and +0.62, and the positive-control and cell-local qualifications are preserved.
The conclusion accurately reports increased effect and negative AF at both seeds and retains implementation and cell scope.
